Actor.description:
Who wrote a record or acted: the session, the program, the person and
the agent's name, each when known, and at least one. Every record type that names who
acted holds one.

agent.description:
The name the agent was given, such as `nightly scheduler`, as
free text.

person.description: The person who acted, such as `ana`, or their email address.

program.description: The program that acted, such as `claude-code` or `codex`.

description:
`places/workspace-change/v1`: one mxv workspace on one machine works on
one change, at `/places/<machine>/<workspace>/changes/<change-name>`.

by.description: Who wrote the record, when known.

change.description: The change the workspace works on.

workspace.description:
The workspace's directory, `/places/<machine>/<workspace>`, which
holds this record's `changes/` directory.

workspace_id.description: The mxv workspace's id when the record was written.

title: WorkspaceChange
